calculatorConfigCards.title: Vendor
calculatorConfigCards.subtitle: Who is providing the commercial offer
calculatorConfigCards.description: Establishes provider-specific defaults, supported contract structures, pricing logic, and sourcing metadata.

calculatorConfigCards.title: Contract structure
calculatorConfigCards.subtitle: How the deal is commercially shaped
calculatorConfigCards.description: Determines whether the estimate behaves like seats, API usage, provisioned throughput, or a hybrid contract.

calculatorConfigCards.title: Usage profile
calculatorConfigCards.subtitle: Starting workload pattern
calculatorConfigCards.description: Seeds the estimator with a light, standard, heavy, or custom baseline so the first estimate is credible quickly.

calculatorConfigCards.title: Deployment mode
calculatorConfigCards.subtitle: Where the workload primarily runs
calculatorConfigCards.description: Sets the initial hosting model and influences downstream infrastructure cost assumptions.

calculatorConfigCards.title: Hosting
calculatorConfigCards.subtitle: Primary hosting assumption
calculatorConfigCards.description: Represents whether the workload is vendor-hosted, tenant-isolated, private hosted, or comparable hosted patterns.

calculatorConfigCards.title: Cloud option
calculatorConfigCards.subtitle: Cloud provider / managed platform path
calculatorConfigCards.description: Captures Azure-hosted, vendor-native hosted, GCP-hosted, AWS-hosted, or none, depending on deal shape.

calculatorConfigCards.title: Provisioned throughput
calculatorConfigCards.subtitle: Reserved performance capacity
calculatorConfigCards.description: Models capacity reservations used for predictable throughput rather than pure elastic pay-as-you-go usage.

calculatorConfigCards.title: Data residency
calculatorConfigCards.subtitle: Region and residency constraints
calculatorConfigCards.description: Applies regional deployment, sovereignty, and data-location assumptions that may affect pricing.

calculatorConfigCards.title: Security / admin overhead
calculatorConfigCards.subtitle: Governance and policy cost layer
calculatorConfigCards.description: Prices the operational overhead associated with security controls, policy enforcement, logging, and admin management.

calculatorConfigCards.title: Hybrid / network
calculatorConfigCards.subtitle: Connectivity and split execution model
calculatorConfigCards.description: Models the cost and behavior of routing work across hosted, local, on-prem, or cloud-adjacent infrastructure.

calculatorConfigCards.title: Power users group
calculatorConfigCards.subtitle: Highest-intensity usage cohort
calculatorConfigCards.description: Defines a high-consumption user cohort with heavier usage, longer prompts, and stronger model needs.

calculatorConfigCards.title: Standard users group
calculatorConfigCards.subtitle: Mid-range steady usage cohort
calculatorConfigCards.description: Defines the mainstream user population with regular but not extreme usage assumptions.

calculatorConfigCards.title: Light users group
calculatorConfigCards.subtitle: Lower-intensity usage cohort
calculatorConfigCards.description: Defines occasional or low-depth users so the estimate is not distorted by averaging everyone together.

calculatorConfigCards.title: Add user group
calculatorConfigCards.subtitle: Create another usage tier
calculatorConfigCards.description: Lets the user define additional cohorts such as contractors, analysts, executives, developers, or seasonal users.

calculatorConfigCards.title: Token grant policy
calculatorConfigCards.subtitle: How usage is governed per user or group
calculatorConfigCards.description: Defines whether token allowances are unlimited, soft-capped, hard-capped, pooled, or role-based.

calculatorConfigCards.title: Activity assumptions
calculatorConfigCards.subtitle: How often users actually consume
calculatorConfigCards.description: Separates assigned users from active users and models real consumption cadence.

calculatorConfigCards.title: Model deployment group
calculatorConfigCards.subtitle: A deployed or assigned model group
calculatorConfigCards.description: Represents a model in the contract mix, including quantity, routing role, and share of use.

calculatorConfigCards.title: Add model
calculatorConfigCards.subtitle: Add another model to the contract mix
calculatorConfigCards.description: Expands the catalog so multiple models can share traffic, roles, or fallback behavior.

calculatorConfigCards.title: Model usage allocation
calculatorConfigCards.subtitle: Percent of total use assigned to a model
calculatorConfigCards.description: Ensures the usage split across all active models equals 100% for the given contract.

calculatorConfigCards.title: Fallback / escalation path
calculatorConfigCards.subtitle: What happens when a model is not sufficient
calculatorConfigCards.description: Defines escalation to stronger models or fallback to cheaper models when policy, quality, or complexity requires it.

calculatorConfigCards.title: Performance
calculatorConfigCards.subtitle: Quality and usefulness weighting group
calculatorConfigCards.description: Parent group for quality and task-fit parameters used to influence modeled cost realism and suitability.

calculatorConfigCards.title: Cost efficiency
calculatorConfigCards.subtitle: Efficiency and cost-shape weighting group
calculatorConfigCards.description: Parent group for attributes that materially influence practical cost beyond headline token pricing.

calculatorConfigCards.title: Reliability
calculatorConfigCards.subtitle: Consistency and operational confidence weighting group
calculatorConfigCards.description: Parent group for the model’s resilience, repeatability, and production confidence profile.

calculatorConfigCards.title: Governance & risk
calculatorConfigCards.subtitle: Compliance, fairness, and ownership weighting group
calculatorConfigCards.description: Parent group for safety, fairness, explainability, and long-term operational responsibility.

calculatorConfigCards.title: Task performance / usefulness
calculatorConfigCards.subtitle: Quality of usable answer
calculatorConfigCards.description: Compares whether the model reliably produces useful results for the intended work.

calculatorConfigCards.title: Generalization / task transfer
calculatorConfigCards.subtitle: Performance outside narrow examples
calculatorConfigCards.description: Compares how well the model handles adjacent or unseen tasks without collapsing in usefulness.

calculatorConfigCards.title: Instruction adherence
calculatorConfigCards.subtitle: How well the model follows directions
calculatorConfigCards.description: Compares reliability in following formatting, tone, constraints, and requested structure.

calculatorConfigCards.title: Transparency / explainability
calculatorConfigCards.subtitle: Ability to justify outputs
calculatorConfigCards.description: Compares how understandable, inspectable, and explainable outputs are in human terms.

calculatorConfigCards.title: Model complexity / sophistication
calculatorConfigCards.subtitle: Depth and computational sophistication
calculatorConfigCards.description: Compares how advanced or computationally heavy the model is, which affects cost and suitability.

calculatorConfigCards.title: Training / adaptation burden
calculatorConfigCards.subtitle: Effort to adapt or specialize
calculatorConfigCards.description: Compares how much work, data, or expertise is required to tailor the model to the use case.

calculatorConfigCards.title: Inference cost efficiency
calculatorConfigCards.subtitle: Practical runtime cost efficiency
calculatorConfigCards.description: Compares cost efficiency during live use, including token efficiency and useful work per dollar.

calculatorConfigCards.title: Scalability / throughput fit
calculatorConfigCards.subtitle: Capacity under scale
calculatorConfigCards.description: Compares how well the model supports large user counts, traffic spikes, and enterprise throughput needs.

calculatorConfigCards.title: Robustness / reliability
calculatorConfigCards.subtitle: Performance under messy inputs
calculatorConfigCards.description: Compares how the model behaves with noisy, incomplete, or adversarial inputs.

calculatorConfigCards.title: Bias / fairness / safety
calculatorConfigCards.subtitle: Fairness and safe behavior
calculatorConfigCards.description: Compares consistency and safety across contexts, groups, and edge cases.

calculatorConfigCards.title: Adaptability / fine-tunability
calculatorConfigCards.subtitle: Ease of evolving the model fit
calculatorConfigCards.description: Compares how easily the model can be tuned, redirected, or reused as requirements change.

calculatorConfigCards.title: Latency / responsiveness
calculatorConfigCards.subtitle: Response speed suitability
calculatorConfigCards.description: Compares how quickly the model returns usable results relative to workflow needs.

calculatorConfigCards.title: Stability / consistency
calculatorConfigCards.subtitle: Consistency under small changes
calculatorConfigCards.description: Compares whether small input differences create predictable or erratic result changes.

calculatorConfigCards.title: Operational maintenance burden
calculatorConfigCards.subtitle: Ongoing ownership cost
calculatorConfigCards.description: Compares the monitoring, retraining, governance, and support burden required to keep the model useful.

calculatorConfigCards.title: Workflow integration efficiency
calculatorConfigCards.subtitle: Fit inside real processes
calculatorConfigCards.description: Compares how naturally the model fits tools, routing, repeated tasks, and automation patterns.
